subject: POC kickoff — backup window & deferred hands-on runbook
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@veridiantech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: devops@veridiantech.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop and load test prep

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the note. We are excited to get the hands-on POC with Redwood scheduled — we want the session to include: a prompt review with our product owners, routing/latency checkpoints with our infra team, and a short load test (50 concurrent tokens) to validate our baselines.

Unfortunately, our lead engineer just flagged a production migration on the originally proposed Thursday slot and we need to move. Can you share a couple of backup windows next week? Prefer mornings between 08:00-11:00 PDT. Also please include any minimal pre-work for the load test (test dataset, IAM hints) so our SREs can prep.

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Product — Veridian Tech
attachments: none
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@veridiantech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop and load test prep

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and totally understood about the migration.

Quick options for next week (all PDT):
- Tue 08/17, 08:30-10:00 (recommended: prompt review + routing validation + 30m load burn)
- Wed 08/18, 09:00-10:30 (backup window)
- Thu 08/19, 08:00-09:30 (earlier slot)

If none of those work we can hold an asynchronous run-through and a separate short load test that your SREs can run with our checklist. I attached the POC-runbook-v1.pdf and a test-data-checklist.xlsx so your engineers have the exact commands and token load profile we use in the lab.

Also: can you confirm who from your side will join? We usually have: Product owner, 1 SRE, and a developer/ML engineer. We’ll bring Marissa (solutions engineer) to run the prompt review and Ben (sales engineer) to coordinate infra.

If you prefer, here’s a Calendly link to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/poc-60min — I can also create a backup (standby) calendar invite that only activates if you don’t cancel 24h prior.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: POC-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF), test-data-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@veridiantech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: devops@veridiantech.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop and load test prep

Jonas — thanks, Tue 08/17 at 08:30 works for our team. I will forward to SRE and confirm names this afternoon.

One note: our SRE asked if we can push the load test to the very end of the session or run it in a separate 30m window immediately after the demo to avoid any interference with our staging rollout. Is that possible?

Also please add a calendar invite with the runbook and an .ics so our calendar can accept the fallback slot in case of last-minute changes.

— Maria
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@veridiantech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop and load test prep

Understood — we’ll schedule the load test as the final 30 minutes by default and also publish a separate 30m post-demo slot if you want to split it out. I created a provisional invite for Tue 08/17 08:30-10:00 PDT and attached backup-slot-confirmation.ics to this thread. Please accept or let us know changes.

If it helps, here’s a lightweight playbook for last-minute no-shows or runbook handover:
- 24h: we send a reminder + pre-test checklist to SRE inbox
- 2h: if any SRE is unavailable we run the async load test on Redwood staging and share the logs
- On-site: Marissa will run the prompt review; Ben will coordinate routing knobs and quantization profile used for the load test

If you think there’s a real chance of conflict due to your migration window, say so and we’ll hold the session in a split format (30m demo + 30m load test later).

Thanks — looking forward.
Jonas
